name: Private Messages
project_description:
Privatemsg allows your site's visitors to send private messages to each other. Perfect for community oriented sites, such as forums and social networking sites.

 What works now: 

 
 Messages list 
 Messages filters 
 Mass actions in messages list (mark as read, mark as unread) 
 Block with new messages counter 
 View messages 
 Delete messages 
 Write new messages to any count of users 
 Write new messages to roles 
 View other messages if you are site admin 
 Email about new messages (checkbox in user profile) 
 Block users 
 Set unblockable role 
 Thread personal tags 
 Views integration
